notes: `נְקַם אַחַת` → *at once* is retained as a rule 30 fusion headed on the governing construct (rule 23) with *once* as the content word rule 24 anchors on. A materially plausible alternative exists — mark the cognate accusative `נְקַם` `unrepresented` under rule 22 and give *at once* whole to `אַחַת` — and a future reviewer should read the unit's note as taking the fusion rather than as excluding that reading.
The 1cs suffix of `אֲדֹנָי` is `unrepresented` and the base noun takes *O Lord* with the vocative *O* joining it (rules 57, 36).
One written determiner *this* answers to the demonstrative pronoun, leaving both articles of `הַפַּעַם הַזֶּה` `unrepresented` (rules 41, 47); the margin was read and set aside (rule 38).
